entities.name: Sostratus of Cnidus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sostratus of Cnidus was a Greek architect and engineer. He is said to have designed the lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, on the island of Pharos off Alexandria, Egypt. This claim is disputed.
